notes.title: Update notes for October 28
notes.content:
After a short break we returned with few improvements:
[list]
[*] Game size reduced. 
[*] Body rotation with joystick is improved.
[*] Translation improvements in all languages. 
[/list]

In the near future you can wait more of the game updates with requested features.

notes.title: Detective VR future plans and updates
notes.content:
Good time of day everyone!
It's been a week since the release of Detective VR and we want to share with you a little plans for the future.
[list]
[*] Update/improve translations for all languages.
[*] Settings screen in the main menu.
[*] Ability to disable tooltips.
[*] Ability to change movement from teleports to locomotion.
[*] WMR devices support.
[*] Bug fixes, stability improvements, etc.
[/list]

If all goes well, we plan to release all of this by the end of 2021.
On top of that we are also preparing a release on Oculus Quest 2, at least in one of the available platforms (stores), which one - time will tell.

And last, but not least, we preparing free content update, which will focus on the past of Hudson, where you will help him to create the elixir (oops, spoilers 😊).

Feel free to write feedback and suggestions. Thank you for being with us.

[/list]
